description: This file contains utility structures and functions for handling semantic versioning, environment checks, command resolution, and installation procedures related to the Gateway environment in the OpenClaw project. It manages version compatibility, environment validation, and process execution for the gateway components.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A lightweight helper struct for semantic versioning (major.minor.patch), with comparison, parsing, and compatibility checks.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentKind
classes.description: An enum representing various states of the gateway environment, including checking, okay, missing components, incompatible versions, and errors.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentStatus
classes.description: A struct representing the status of the environment check, including its kind, versions, and a message.

classes.name: GatewayCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the result of resolving the gateway command, including status and the command array.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the gateway, checking environment variables, config, defaults.

methods.name: expectedGatewayVersion
methods.description: Parses and returns the expected gateway version as a Semver object based on bundle info.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs environment checks: version compatibility, presence of required executables, and returns a status object.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the command to run the gateway, considering environment and configuration.

methods.name: installGlobal
methods.description: Installs or updates the openclaw gateway CLI globally via npm, pnpm, or bun, using async execution.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayVersionOutput
methods.description: Normalizes the raw output string for version comparison, stripping common prefixes.

methods.name: readGatewayVersion
methods.description: Runs the gateway executable with --version to capture and parse the version number as Semver.

methods.name: readLocalGatewayVersion
methods.description: Reads the local project’s package.json to extract the version number for comparison.
